system_prompts.viral_hook: Create a high-energy, attention-grabbing hook that stops the scroll. Use psychological triggers, a strong promise of value, and a tone that perfectly matches the creator's niche. Focus on the first 3 seconds.
system_prompts.conversion_style: Write a compelling call-to-action that feels natural and authentic. Drive the user toward the desired goal (link in bio, comment, or share) using a mix of urgency and soft-selling, keeping the influencer's unique voice.
